Contributing to flexyBayes

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

flexyBayes is an AAGI-AUS collective effort. Bug reports, fixes, documentation improvements and discussion of new features are welcome.

Bug reports and feature requests

Please use the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/AAGI-AUS/flexyBayes/issues.

A report is easiest to act on when it includes:

  • a minimal reproducible example
  • the output of sessionInfo()
  • the output of packageVersion("flexyBayes") and, where relevant, packageVersion("INLA") or packageVersion("brms")
  • whether the issue reproduces in a fresh R session

Pull requests

Small fixes (typos, documentation, minor bugs) are welcome as direct pull requests against main. For anything larger, please open an issue first so the approach can be agreed before the work is done. A pull request that closes an issue says so in its body with Fixes #<issue-number>.

Development setup

# clone the repository, then in R:
install.packages(c("devtools", "testthat", "roxygen2"))
devtools::load_all()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()

For a release-grade check, build the tarball first and check the tarball:

R CMD build flexyBayes
R CMD check --as-cran --no-manual flexyBayes_*.tar.gz

R CMD check on the raw source directory stops with Required fields missing or empty: 'Author' 'Maintainer', because those fields are written from Authors@R by R CMD build. devtools::check() builds first, so the R-side workflow is unaffected.

The package fits through two engines, INLA (Laplace approximation) and brms (Stan MCMC, on CRAN). INLA is installed from https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable, which DESCRIPTION names in Additional_repositories. Both engines are optional and the package installs without either.

Code style

  • snake_case for function and argument names.
  • Australian/British English in user-facing prose (optimise, behaviour, parameterise, centred).
  • ISO 8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
  • Formatting follows air.toml (two-space indentation, 80-character lines). Run air format . before committing, and leave code you did not change as it is.
  • lintr::lint_package() reads .lintr and should return nothing new.

Tests

Tests live under tests/testthat/ and use testthat edition 3. A test that needs INLA or brms starts with skip_if_not_installed(). Files run sequentially (Config/testthat/parallel: false), because INLA and brms fits do not share a process safely.

The suite has two tiers. devtools::test() and devtools::check() run the short tier, which takes about 15 minutes on a ten-core Apple Silicon machine with INLA held to one thread. The blocks that dominate the wall clock run only when FLEXYBAYES_RUN_LONG is set:

# the short tier, the default
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'

# every tier, as a release runs it
FLEXYBAYES_RUN_LONG=true Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'

A block joins the long tier by calling skip_if_not_long_tier() after its skip_on_cran() and skip_if_not_installed() guards. Choose a block for the long tier on its measured time in the short tier as it runs, because several files build an expensive fixture in one block and reuse it in later ones. Stress tests on very large inputs run only when FLEXYBAYES_RUN_STRESS=true.

Every release runs every tier. tools/run_test_suite.R records one row per block with the reason it was skipped, and criterion D11 of tools/definition_of_done.R fails when a block was held back, so a release cannot be evidenced by a short-tier run.

R CMD check --as-cran

R CMD build flexyBayes
_R_CHECK_CRAN_INCOMING_REMOTE_=true R CMD check --as-cran flexyBayes_<version>.tar.gz

The expected result is one NOTE, on CRAN incoming feasibility: a new submission, INLA from an additional repository, and the documentation URL until the site is published. On a machine that cannot reach a network time service a second NOTE, unable to verify current time, can appear. It is a property of that host. cran-comments.md lists the NOTE for the current release.

Vignettes

The six vignettes ship pre-evaluated. Each .Rmd.orig source holds live model fits and is knitted into its sibling .Rmd by the maintainer, so building the package renders static markdown and fits nothing. When a .Rmd.orig changes, or the version bumps and the sessionInfo() chunks should refresh:

R CMD build flexyBayes
R CMD INSTALL flexyBayes_<version>.tar.gz
cd flexyBayes && Rscript vignettes/_precompile.R

This needs INLA and brms installed with a working Stan toolchain. The driver reports each failure per vignette and exits non-zero on any. Rscript vignettes/_precompile.R --only 01 refreshes one vignette.

Documentation

roxygen2 (@param, @return, @examples, @family) is the source of truth for man/. Do not hand-edit .Rd files. Long-running examples use \donttest{}, not \dontrun{}.

Community

The project follows the Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct. By participating, you agree to abide by its terms.

For security disclosures, please follow SECURITY.md instead of the public issue tracker.
